rachel: short convo: propose 'jittered fanout' pattern to avoid thundering herd + accidental residency leaks. coordinator decides routing and adds Fanout-Trace.

tom: high level rules?

rachel: 1) tenant has resident-region -> local-only. 2) model missing in region -> staged fanout with per-tenant token bucket and jitter. 3) consent/PII -> block fanout.

ali: on cache miss for residency policy?

rachel: consult local policy cache (TTL 45s). if miss -> sync to policy service with 50ms timeout; on timeout default to conservative (block cross-region).

tom: how to avoid ramp storms during failover?

rachel: per-tenant circuit states: CLOSED, THROTTLED, OPEN. on region error rate spike -> set THROTTLED and allow X fanouts/sec with randomized delay in [50ms, 500ms].

ali: observability requests:
- Fanout-Trace header: ft=region;tenant=id;state=THROTTLED;seq=5;attempts=2
- logs include tried regions and final served_region

ops-bot: deploy: jittered-fanout-coordinator v0.1 canary started eu-west-1 at 1773334460.

tom: runbook notes: emergency override token must be short-lived + audited. operator steps to reduce fanout: patch FANOUT_GLOBAL_MAX, set THROTTLED defaults higher, revoke override tokens.

ali: test plan: chaos job toggling consent flags + synthetic load of 5k tenants to validate per-tenant qps.

rachel: I'll write a short RFC with sequence diagram and failure matrix, add cost_estimate_tokens to response. tagging arch for review.
